items.name: A Spanish Plague
items.where: Take it from Milo at the docks; sink 3 ships at the marked spot.
items.gate: First contract; offered after Sequence 04 Mission 01 (This Old Cove)

items.name: Eye For An Eye
items.where: Take it from Milo at the docks; board the San Lorenzo frigate.
items.reward: Money; bonus 900 Reales for incapacitating it without mortars

items.name: Blind Justice
items.where: Take it from Milo at the docks; board the British Man O' War.
items.reward: Money; bonus 900 Reales for sinking its 3 escorts before boarding

items.name: Papers, Please
items.where: Take it from Milo in town; sink the HMS Courage.
items.reward: Money; bonus 1200 Reales if you board it instead

items.name: The Final Contract
items.where: Take it from Milo by the manor; protect the Hollander and sink all 10 attacking ships.
items.gate: Requires finishing all other naval contracts
items.reward: Handsome Devils Crew Attire (Rare) and Black Skull Sails (Legendary)

items.name: A Personal Matter
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink the frigate HMS Defiance.
items.reward: Money; bonus 900 Reales if you board it

items.name: The Law Of The Ocean
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; wait for the ambush, then board and take over the Hercules.
items.reward: Money; bonus 900 Reales for sinking a ship with fire barrels

items.name: Silk On The Waves
items.region: Dry Tortuga region - Salt Key Bank
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink or plunder ships to gather 30 cloth (cloth already carried does not count), then return.

items.name: Driftwood
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink or plunder ships to gather 60 wood (already-carried wood does not count), then return.

items.name: Weathering The Storm
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink the 5-ship British fleet.
items.reward: Money; bonus 600 Reales for sinking 2 of them with mortars

items.name: The Realities Of War
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink all Spanish ships.
items.reward: Money; bonus 1200 Reales for sinking one Spanish ship with a mortar

items.name: Contraband
items.where: Take it from the man at the docks; sink all smuggler ships.

items.name: Private Escort
items.where: Take it from the man beside the Harbourmaster; escort the Neptuno through waves of small ships and one medium ship to open water near Serranilla.
items.reward: Money; bonus 1200 Reales if the Neptuno ends with at least 50% health

items.name: Smuggler's Den
items.where: Take it from the man on the dock where you moor the Jackdaw; destroy the 3-ship Spanish blockade, crippling the small ships first so they cannot hit you.
items.reward: Money; extra Reales (amount not stated) for sinking the medium frigate with a mortar

items.name: Hunter Gatherer
items.where: Take it from the man on the dock where you moor the Jackdaw; sink 2 Hunter ships (red sails, pirate icon).
items.gate: Needs Wanted Level 1 or more for Hunter ships to appear; they can find you anywhere
items.reward: Money; bonus for sinking one Hunter ship with a mortar (aim, then fire when the ship shows the Board prompt)

gaps: Source gives base rewards only as 'money'; no base amounts.
Source does not say whether any contract is tied to a trophy.
notes: Nothing is missable and all locations stay reachable after the story. Contracts show on the map after syncing viewpoints; the map filter can show only naval contracts. Readers report Hunter Gatherer and Contraband sometimes stay open on the map after completion (not addressed by the guide).
